mapper.update: UPDATE agent_draft_assist_run SET status=#{status},version=#{version},state_json=#{stateJson} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status=#{previous} AND context_json=#{contextJson}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM agent_draft_assist_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT id FROM agent_draft_assist_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT q.tenant_id,q.id,q.trace_id,a.business_no FROM agent_draft_assist_run q LEFT JOIN approval_application a ON a.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND a.id=q.application_id WHERE q.status='QUEUED' OR (q.status='RUNNING' AND q.lease_until<=#{leaseUntil}) ORDER BY q.created_at,q.id LIMIT 10
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_draft_assist_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND application_id=#{applicationId} AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')
SELECT lease_until FROM agent_draft_assist_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_draft_assist_run SET lease_until=#{leaseUntil} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id,application_version,status,version,created_at FROM agent_draft_assist_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND application_id=#{applicationId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_draft_assist_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND application_id=#{applicationId}
